title: Team
description: Schema for a team registration file.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the filename (without .json).

description.description: A brief description of the team or project.

maintainers.description: Contributor filenames (without .json) who are maintainers. Maintainers receive elevated repository permissions and team management rights.

contributors.description: Contributor filenames (without .json) who are contributors. All maintainers should also appear here.

repos.description: Repository filenames (without .json) from the repos/ directory. Platform-specific details are defined in each repository file.

figma_projects.description: Figma project filenames (without .json) from the figma-projects/ directory.

google_files.description: Google file slugs (without .json) from the google-files/ directory.

sync_github.description: When true, automatically sync team membership and repo access to GitHub.

sync_forgejo.description: When true, automatically sync team membership and repo access to Forgejo/Codeberg.

remove_unlisted.description: When true, members not listed in this file will be removed from the platform team. Set to false during migration periods.
